polypulse.title: PolyPulse — Cross-Venue Prediction-Market Orderbook & Markout Pipeline
polypulse.line1: High-throughput market data ingestion and orderbook computation engine architected in C++20 and Python AsyncIO to provide unified cross-venue prediction-market execution analysis.
polypulse.line2: Verified by empirical hardware microbenchmarks to deliver 56.39M ops/sec throughput and 17.00 ns p50 latency on in-place level updates with ClickHouse analytical storage.

distributed-flash-sale-engine.title: Distributed Flash-Sale Engine — High-Throughput Ticket Booking Architecture
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line1: High-concurrency distributed ticketing engine designed to eliminate overbooking and TOCTOU race conditions under sudden 10,000+ RPS demand spikes.
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line2: Employs single-threaded Redis Lua scripts and Redlock distributed locks to guarantee 0.00% overbooking and sub-25ms p95 latency under automated k6 stress testing.

AegisOps.title: AegisOps — Autonomous AIOps Blast-Radius Engine & Self-Healing K8s Operator
AegisOps.line1: Autonomous incident remediation control plane and Kubernetes operator that protects sensitive telemetry, maps microservice blast radius, and executes safe runbook automations.
AegisOps.line2: Features Keycloak OIDC/TOTP human approval gates, hybrid pgvector runbook retrieval, and 65/65 passing CI tests with unbroken 60-second recovery health proofs.

PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.title: PayGuard AI — Agentic Payment Dispute Triage & Regulatory RAG Engine
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line1: Autonomous multi-agent triage system that normalizes multi-rail payment payloads and resolves chargeback disputes against indexed regulatory protocols.
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line2: Backed by an independently audited 178/178 passing test suite across 20 modules in 93.93s, implementing pgvector semantic retrieval and strict multi-tenant isolation.

Bastion-hybrid-rag.title: Bastion — Zero-Leak Multi-Tenant Hybrid RAG Engine
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line1: Multi-tenant retrieval-augmented generation engine combining reciprocal rank fusion over PostgreSQL 17 pgvector and full-text search with Redis 8 scoped semantic caching.
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line2: Enforces strict tenant isolation with a verified two-cohort Ragas evaluation harness comparing dense baselines against 14 adversarial RBAC and refusal traps.

ric0fc.title: RicozViz — Enterprise BI & Analytical Exploration Platform
ric0fc.line1: Dual-storage business intelligence platform combining DuckDB for sub-second analytical file queries with PostgreSQL for transactional metadata and server-side RBAC.
ric0fc.line2: Verified with 42/42 security audit tests passed and clean 12/12 Playwright E2E page validations, featuring cryptographic 192-bit share tokens and live cloud deployment.

Glamgo.title: GlamGo — Beauty Retail Marketplace & Instant Booking Platform
Glamgo.line1: Unified full-stack e-commerce and salon booking platform with server-verified pricing, 10% coupon validation caps, and HTTP 409 double-booking concurrency guards.
Glamgo.line2: Production-deployed with live Vercel storefront and Render API docs, protected by multi-vendor escrow workflows, Redis caching, and Playwright verification.

StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.title: StockPulse — Multi-Tenant Inventory & POS Order Engine
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line1: High-concurrency B2B inventory management and POS transaction engine supporting tenant-isolated catalog schemas and multi-warehouse stock allocations.
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line2: Verified with automated CI build validation, Docker Compose deployment, Prisma database migrations, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance.

Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.title: OrderFlow — Multi-Restaurant Commerce & Real-Time Fulfillment Engine
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line1: Multi-restaurant ordering and kitchen fulfillment platform utilizing WebSocket events for bidirectional real-time order status tracking and kitchen ticket management.
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line2: Backed by an automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline, Prisma ORM schema migrations on PostgreSQL 15, and Vitest test execution.

Medicine-Link.title: MedicineLink — Surplus Medicine Redistribution Platform
Medicine-Link.line1: Academic healthcare redistribution platform engineered to track synthetic surplus pharmaceutical inventory and coordinate multi-role donation requests.
Medicine-Link.line2: Built with full-stack TypeScript, verified with passing Vitest suites, and structured around lightweight SQLite persistence and Express REST endpoints.
